text: 国家统计局：10月份CPI同比继续上涨 PPI环比涨幅回落 受国际市场价格变动影响，国内汽油价格上涨4.2%，涨幅比上月回落0.7个百分点，影响CPI环比上涨约0.14个百分点。
text_en: National Bureau of Statistics: October CPI continued to rise year-on-year; PPI month-on-month increase slowed. Affected by international market price changes, domestic gasoline prices rose 4.2%, 0.7 percentage points slower than last month, contributing about 0.14 percentage points to the month-on-month CPI increase.
